about_the_game:
Trick or Treat: The Legend of Samhain – Halloween brings chaos, candy, and mischievous fun. Step into the shoes of Jimmy, an 8-year-old prankster, as he navigates a wild and spooky night full of surprises. From sneaking into haunted houses to pulling outrageous pranks, every corner hides adventure, danger, and laughter. Can you master stealth, strategy, and chaos to survive the night and collect the ultimate candy haul?

Note: The game includes playful dark humor, suitable for mature jokes and mischievous situations.

In this 3D action-adventure with platforming and stealth mechanics, players can:

  • Explore richly detailed Halloween environments, from creepy streets to haunted houses.

  • Execute creative pranks and clever stealth maneuvers to outsmart spooky NPCs.

  • Experience a dynamic chaos system that reacts to your mischief.

  • Unlock secrets, collectibles, and hidden candy caches across multiple levels.

  • Enjoy a whimsical, Tim Burton-inspired aesthetic blending fun and suspense.

Get ready for a night of tricks, treats, and unpredictable chaos – Jimmy’s adventure is just beginning!

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoonish violence in the streets and a touch of dark humor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Runs best at 1080p / 60fps on recommended specs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
